about_the_game:
In the year 2050, the world as we know it has been devastated by a cataclysmic event known as "The Surge." This event was triggered by a failed scientific experiment intended to harness a new energy source. Instead, it tore open rifts in reality, causing widespread destruction and scattering powerful artifacts across the globe. These artifacts hold immense power, capable of granting their wielders extraordinary abilities. Nations and factions now fight for control over these artifacts, leading to constant conflict and chaos

Explore Find your way trough out the wasteland and scorched lands of the Surge

Find And Gather Resources-Riftbound world is filled with all types off resources from Wood logs to Riftboundium Ore


Build-construction components and placeable items 
FightFight areas of enemies and to upgrade your arsenal and base

content_descriptors.notes: Rift hunting , shoting guns , swinging blades

short_description: Riftbound: Legacy of the Surge is a team-based survival shooter set in a world of floating lands and deadly rifts. Build your base, craft gear, conquer rifts, trade with NPCs, and use powerful gear like jetpacks and teleport rings to raid enemies and fight for total domination
